capture_position: last prefix anchor / final user-content byte token
graph_budget: all controls have exactly the Menger 20-node edge count; unweighted undirected
projection: fixed signed hash projection of native 64-dimensional binary32 vectors into 3 axes; rank minmax fit on calibration indices only; clamp evaluation into [0,2]
score: nearest-evaluation-neighbor graph hop sum and same-or-adjacent hit count; lower hops/higher hits descriptive only
statistics: no significance, no generalization, no causal or superiority claim
